name: Sufrai
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.note: Retired ISO code (Sufrai), split into Tarpia [tpf] and Kaptiau [kbi] in 2008; no own description

sources.citation: Mariati S., Sitti. 2020. Adverbia bahasa Tarfia [Adverbs in Tarfia]. Kelasa 15(2):318-338. doi:10.26499/kelasa.v15i2.114 (Balai Bahasa Papua author; Tarfia of Kampung Kamdera, Distrik Demta, Kab. Jayapura).
sources.note: Nothing (no hits for tekanan/aksen/suprasegmental). Adverb inventory and syntax only. Useful for identity: equates Tarfia with Ethnologue Tarpia (Kaptiauw, Sufrai) and its vocabulary matches the ASJP Tarpia list (pipiu 'new', taya 'name', arko 'two', tasi 'younger sibling').

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (Randy Lebold, SIL). 2007. Change Request Number 2007-231: split [suf] into Tarpia [tpf] and Kaptiau [kbi] (adopted 2008-01-14). Dallas: SIL International. 8 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. Administrative document: 37% lexical similarity between Tarpia and Kaptiau villages from an SIL survey (March 2006); cites only a draft 'Survey Report on the Bonggo, Tarpia, and Kaptiau languages'.

sources.citation: Grace, George W. 1970. Notes on the phonological history of the Austronesian languages of the Sarmi Coast. Working Papers in Linguistics (University of Hawaii) 2(9):55-104 [ERIC ED054658; republished Oceanic Linguistics 10:11-37, 1971]. Covers Sobei, Wakde, Masimasi, Anus, Bonggo, Tarpia.
sources.note: Silent on stress/accent (a full-text search for stress/accent full text: zero hits for stress/accent/penult). Diachronic segmental correspondences from Grace's own 1955-56 TRIPP wordlists, which he says 'cannot make any pretense of being systematically phonemic' (p.103); no accent marks in the cognate list.

sources.citation: Sanjoko, Yohanis and Novaria Panggabean. 2020. Sintaksis bahasa Tarfia; Mariati, Sitti and Yulius Pagappong. 2020. Morfologi bahasa Tarfia. Jayapura: Balai Bahasa Papua.
